leadText: David Wills is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is sometimes credited as Dave Wills.
plainText:
David Wills is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is sometimes credited as Dave Wills.

==Biography==
Wills first began to provide voices for during the sixth season. As with most other voice actors who worked with 4Kids Entertainment, he left when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. Years later, he provided the voice of Dolan in To Catch a Pokémon Smuggler!, making him the first former 4Kids voice actor to return to the in .

He is also a radio talk show host by the name of "Ghosty" on WFDU.
